name: Trading OS v3 — Daily Digest
flow: Daily 06:30 IST (scheduleTrigger, days interval, triggerAtHour 6 triggerAtMinute 30, workflow tz Asia/Kolkata) -> Get Positions (Digest) (positions_state all rows) -> Get Ledger Rows (trade_ledger all rows, executeOnce) -> Get Brief (Digest) (daily_brief all rows, executeOnce, alwaysOutputData) -> Build Digest (code) -> Send Digest (telegram chat {{TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}}, HTML, credential {{CREDENTIAL_ID}})
digest_logic: Weekend (IST Sat/Sun): send only if any OPEN position has pending_action, else skip silently. Sections: (1) Brain brief - latest daily_brief row if created_at within 24h, else 'No brain brief in last 24h'; (2) per OPEN position: price, hard_stop, % distance, 20d high, TP; earnings flag when next_earnings within 5 days ('tight-stop rules apply'); pending_action with age - >20h flagged 'STILL PENDING - nag'; (3) cash reminder line (no API feed); (4) trade_ledger events from last 24h or 'No ledger events'.
_note: Condensed export 2026-08-11 (instance public API disabled). Live workflow is source of truth: your n8n instance, workflow {{WF_DAILY_DIGEST_ID}}.
